title: L Catterton Backs InMobi-Backed Glance To Expand Its AI Shopping Business In US
script:
Investment firm L Catterton just backed InMobi-backed Glance to expand its AI shopping business in the United States.
Glance operates a lock screen platform that serves personalized content and interactive shopping features directly to mobile devices.
The strategic funding will fuel its new AI commerce push across American smartphone markets.
Parent company InMobi originally launched Glance in India before scaling the service to international regions.
Would you buy products directly from your phone lock screen?
